name: megascenes-photo-restoration
description: Restore old or damaged photos from your MegaScenes library: scratches, tears, creases, stains and faded colors repaired, the same photo with the same people.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a scan or a photo of the print from your MegaScenes library and say what to fix: a tear across the corner, water stains, a crease, faded colors, dust and scratches. Keep its own colors or black and white, or also colorize it. You get the same photo, repaired and gently sharpened, with the same composition, people and background.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the restoration needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The photo opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For family albums, old portraits, photos for an anniversary or a memorial, and prints that have faded over the years.

Limitations: the repaired parts are redrawn by the model, so details can differ from the original; if you also colorize it, the colors are a plausible interpretation, not the real ones. Only your own or your family's photos that you have the right to edit, never a famous person. One photo per run, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Repair scratches, tears, stains and fading
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Restore the torn old photo of my grandmother in my MegaScenes library
Fix the water stains and the crease on my latest upload
Restore and colorize the faded family photo in my library

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Restore the old photo of my grandmother in my MegaScenes library: there is a tear across the corner. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one restored photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can restore a photo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The restoration models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Restore the faded family photo in my MegaScenes library, fix the water stains and keep it black and white. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my restored photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my restored photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
